name: Kōsa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kōsa town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a cross with a small star.
history: Municipal flag of Kōsa, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 March 1958.

features.role: Kōsa town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a cross with a small star
